description: Buffy’s world is rewritten around a sister she never had, and protecting Dawn from the exiled god Glory becomes inseparable from caring for Joyce, questioning the Slayer’s origins and deciding how much Buffy is willing to sacrifice.

s05e01.description: Count Dracula arrives in Sunnydale and uses his legend, glamour and psychological control to unsettle Buffy, while Xander becomes his unwilling servant and Buffy questions the source of her Slayer power.

s05e02.description: Buffy’s suddenly very real younger sister Dawn complicates patrols and family life, then becomes the target of Harmony’s inept vampire gang.

s05e03.description: A demon’s attack splits Xander into two physically separate versions of himself, forcing his friends to determine which one is real before the divided halves can be permanently lost.

s05e04.description: Riley’s Initiative-enhanced heart begins failing, while Spike exploits the crisis to force a surgeon to remove the behavioral chip that prevents him from harming humans.

s05e05.description: A mysterious orb and a dying monk reveal the impossible truth about Dawn: she is the Key, transformed into Buffy’s sister and hidden from the powerful Glory.

s05e06.description: Tara’s family arrives claiming she will become a demon on her birthday, prompting Tara to cast a spell that hides demons from Buffy and her friends and accidentally puts them all at risk.

s05e07.description: After a vampire nearly kills her, Buffy asks Spike how he defeated two previous Slayers, and his account reveals the long history that shaped both his violence and his obsession with her.

s05e08.description: Glory conjures a monstrous snake to locate the Key, forcing Buffy to stop it before it can identify Dawn while Joyce’s unexplained illness becomes increasingly serious.

s05e09.description: As Joyce prepares for brain surgery, a creature drawn to mental instability attacks vulnerable people and infiltrates the Summers home, where Dawn and Joyce are both exposed.

s05e10.description: Spike reveals that Riley has been secretly allowing vampires to feed on him, forcing Buffy to confront the collapse of their relationship before Riley makes a decision about leaving Sunnydale.

s05e11.description: Willow and Anya’s constant friction at the Magic Box accidentally summons Olaf, Anya’s former troll lover, whose destructive return forces them to reassess their rivalry.

s05e12.description: The Watchers Council arrives with information about Glory but insists Buffy pass an intrusive evaluation first, until Buffy realizes they need her far more than she needs their approval.

s05e13.description: Dawn discovers that she is the Key and spirals into a crisis over whether her memories and identity are real, while Glory closes in on the Summers family.

s05e14.description: Spike finally confesses his love to Buffy just as Drusilla returns hoping to restore him to his old murderous self, leaving Spike caught between obsession, loyalty and his vampire past.

s05e15.description: A distraught robot created to be the perfect girlfriend searches for the man who abandoned her, forcing Buffy to stop her while confronting uncomfortable questions about love and dependence.

s05e16.description: Buffy finds Joyce dead at home, and the episode follows Buffy, Dawn and their friends through the immediate shock and ordinary practical realities of sudden loss.

s05e17.description: Dawn becomes determined to resurrect Joyce through magic despite Buffy’s objections, while Angel returns briefly to support Buffy through her grief.

s05e18.description: While Buffy undergoes a Slayer vision quest, Buffy’s friends mistake Spike’s custom-made Buffy robot for the real Buffy and Glory’s minions kidnap Spike believing he may be the Key.

s05e19.description: Buffy struggles to become Dawn’s guardian as Glory attacks Tara and damages her mind, pushing Willow into a dangerous magical confrontation with the hell-god.

s05e20.description: After Glory finally identifies Dawn as the Key, Buffy leads the group out of Sunnydale while the Knights of Byzantium pursue them with their own lethal solution to the threat.

s05e21.description: Glory’s capture of Dawn leaves Buffy catatonic with guilt, and Willow enters Buffy’s mind to bring her back before the ritual to open dimensional barriers begins.

s05e22.description: Glory prepares to use Dawn’s blood to tear open the walls between dimensions, forcing Buffy and her friends into a final battle whose solution demands an irreversible sacrifice.
